handoffRequirements: Registry join: when Batches 27, 28 and 34 add 'skillsSh:makeGlobal', 'mcpDirectory:makeGlobal', 'harness:get-install-migration-notice' and 'harness:dismiss-install-migration-notice' to their handler METHODS, this owner (Batch 17) must in the SAME cohort change `RpcMethodRegistry extends ProviderAccountRpcMethodRegistry` to also extend InstallScopeRpcMethodRegistry and add the four keys to RPC_METHOD_ENTRIES. Either half alone fails typecheck (METHODS typed as RpcMethodName) or assertManifestInvariants (manifest.spec.ts, rpc-allowlist.spec.ts, Electron dev boot). Prefixes skillsSh:, mcpDirectory:, harness: are already in ALLOWED_METHOD_PREFIXES (vscode-core rpc-handler.ts:70-75).
Batch 28 switches the handler annotation at mcp-directory-rpc.handlers.ts:442 from McpDirectoryInstallParams/Result to McpDirectoryScopedInstallParams/Result.
Batch 40 / 34: the notice result is wrapped `{ notice: ... | null }`, not a bare null.
Kept-path reasons (edited | git-tracked | unverifiable) are NOT in the notice contract: the design shows paths only, and the reason union belongs to Batch 21 (harness-sync.types.ts).

decisions.evidence: assertManifestInvariants requires every RPC_METHOD_NAMES entry to have a manifest owner (rpc-handlers host-profile/manifest.ts:539-569); it runs in manifest.spec.ts:77, rpc-allowlist.spec.ts:64 and at Electron dev boot (register-rpc-surface.ts:141-143). The sub-registry pattern exists: ProviderAccountRpcMethodRegistry (rpc-provider-accounts.types.ts:283, merged via extends at rpc.types.ts RpcMethodRegistry).

If the coordinator extends ownership, the scope field can move onto McpDirectoryInstallParams and the two Scoped types be deleted.

decisions.decision: Home targets typed as Extract<McpInstallTarget, 'codex' | 'copilot' | 'antigravity'> (McpHomeInstallTarget); mcpDirectory:makeGlobal.homeTargets is required (new method, [] means none).
decisions.evidence: Plan D-4 `homeTargets: ('codex'|'copilot'|'antigravity')[]`; mirrors private USER_SCOPE_TARGETS (capability-toggle.types.ts:305-309). Optional-only rule applies to existing methods.

decisions.decision: Notice RPC result wrapped as { notice: InstallMigrationNotice | null }.
decisions.evidence: Every registry result is an object; a wrapper keeps the null case explicit for the transport and lets fields be added without a breaking change.
